subject: Status of our shipment FRA to ORD, 1076 kg
body:
Hello,

could you please tell me the current status of our shipment: Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, FRA to ORD, 1076 kg, ready on 2026-11-27? Where is it now?

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm

classification.reasoning: The sender asks for the shipment’s current status and location.
